meta.name: pr-lens
meta.description: WHAT: Draws a code change or part of a codebase as an animated architecture or data-flow diagram, on its own or in a pull request. WHEN: asked to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. KEYWORDS: PR Lens, diagram, architecture, data flow, visualise, visualize, pull request

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 画出代码改动的动态架构图,让系统结构一目了然
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次审代码都要费劲想象数据怎么流。
copy.tagline_en: Turn code changes into animated architecture and data-flow diagrams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often review big diffs and wish the data flow were drawn for you.

howto.what: 装上后,要求做图或解说代码改动时,它会读取改动内容,把代码画成动态架构图或数据流图,写入项目文件并生成可视化页面或链接。若是发起的 Pull Request,还会把图附到 PR 描述里。
howto.when: 你让它画图、图解或解说某段改动或系统,或在应带图的 Pull Request 中提出需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我画一下这次改动的架构图
say.note: 会读取改动并生成架构预览链接

say.text: 给这个 PR 加上数据流图说明
say.note: 改动会附带图并贴入 PR 描述

say.text: 解释这个模块的依赖是怎么流动的
say.note: 会生成可视化的数据流示意

howto.what_en: When asked to visualise or explain a change or system, it reads the code or diff, writes its structure as a JSON document, and renders animated architecture or data-flow diagrams. It can open them on a shareable canvas, and attach them to a pull request body.
howto.when_en: The skill activates when you ask it to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram.

say_en.text: Diagram the architecture for this change
say_en.note: It reads the diff and shows you a shareable diagram

say_en.text: Add an architecture diagram to this PR
say_en.note: The diagram gets attached to the PR description

say_en.text: Show how data flows inside this module
say_en.note: It renders the flow as an animated diagram
